name: Gryphon Street
desc1: Gryphons have long been revered in the cities of light and the
desc2: followers of good. This street was once named in honor of the tales
desc3: of these great creatures, as told by the library's historians.
desc4: However, Gryphon street has probably seen better days. The western
desc5: half of the street may have once held majestic buildings, but they
desc6: have been reduced to rubble, and the western side appears to lead
desc7: to a small housing community for some of the city's less fortunate.
